## 🧠 COURSE RULES & CONTEXT (Session 6)

- **GREEN candle path**: LOW → HIGH (low pehle print hota hai)
- **RED candle path**: HIGH → LOW (high pehle print hota hai)
- **Inside candle ka far-side extreme** = pending level; jab future candle cross kare tab mark hota hai
- **Gap-down on buying bias** = retracement ALREADY done (S6:123)
- **Continuous same-direction breaks WITHOUT opposite sweep** = EK HI extended leg (naya pivot NAHI)
- Swing magnitude fixed NAHI hai — 5 se 50 pts tak range hoti hai (fixed threshold FAIL)
